mandatory_order: No-LLM critical path: adapters, L0-symbolic-heuristic, L0-symbolic-random, difficulty calibration.
Power gate: no LLM arm runs until L0-random solve_rate < 0.7 in the hardest matched-budget bin for that benchmark.
vLLM in parallel: Qwen3.5 on port 8001 with gpu_memory_utilization=0.30 and parseable-rate smoke.
LLM arms only on calibrated bins: graph_color first, then zebra_puzzles and sudoku.
execution_order_addendum.reason: No-LLM arms determine whether a bin has comparison power; running LLM on non-discriminating bins repeats the Item070 power failure at higher cost.

honesty.does_not_establish: This is preregistration and harness preflight for the externalization paper validation. It banks no new claim result beyond Item070 and Item076 anchors.
honesty.main_blockers: The execution-order addendum makes no-LLM adapters, L0 baselines, and difficulty power calibration the next critical path. vLLM may be brought up in parallel but must not be used on a benchmark before its power gate passes.

kills_and_forks.kill_or_scope: If L1-oneshot-thinking >0.3 on hard bins, scope claim1 to vanilla one-shot cannot search; thinking partially can.
Confirmed only if solve_rate rises monotonically with R and saturates on at least two Tier-1 benchmarks.
If M-register is within noise of L0-symbolic-random/heuristic at matched budget, bank the negative and frame external structure rather than LLM decision superiority.
If ToT or best-of/selfverify match M-register, narrow contribution to bounded-memory/prompt-flat efficiency.
Claim3 remains structure-dependent unless separator venues show CBJ flat while chrono rises.
If frozen-LLM team-over-monolith gap does not open past single-register capacity, scope the real-LLM capacity result while preserving symbolic positive.

item070_claims_1_2.single_next_move: Install/lock AgentsNet dependencies and run real multi-agent contrast, or implement zebra_puzzles CSP runner for external validity.

item070_honesty.claim4_limit: At R=8 the LLM target source is high and close to oracle, but random is also high; this is a high-solve placement, not a clean large separation of target-selection quality.
item070_honesty.does_not_establish: This item establishes a positive real-LLM result for claims 1+2 on Reasoning Gym graph_color only. It does not establish zebra transfer, P1c, or real multi-agent AgentsNet claims.
item070_honesty.multiagent_limit: The real multi-agent run was skipped because the full AgentsNet runtime could not import without langchain/scipy. The dry-run used a recorded fallback matching the official Coloring.get_score formula, so it is readiness evidence, not a real multi-agent LLM result.
item070_honesty.scope_limit: The official-harness result is for graph_color. zebra_puzzles remains skipped/gated, and AgentsNet real-LLM validation remains dependency-gated.
